name: choose-flow
title_zh: 先估工作量再挑下一步的岔路口指路牌
tagline_zh: 开工前先掂量这活是直接实现、补规格、还是拆票——省得你一头扎进大坑里，干到一半才发现该先写文档。
tagline_en: Before you dive in, it sizes the task and tells you: implement, spec it, or split into tickets. Avoids the.
desc_en: Estimate the size of the current work and recommend whether to use /implement, /to-spec, or /to-tickets next.
why_zh: 它不猜你的意图，而是按当前工作的实际规模做分流——把「下一步该干嘛」从拍脑袋变成可重复的判断。
why_en: It doesn't guess intent—it routes by actual task size, turning "what next" from a gut call into a repeatable decision.
limit_zh: 只对代码仓库里的工作项做估算，不覆盖设计、调研或纯文档任务；产物是一句建议，不会替你执行任何一步。
limit_en: Only sizes coding work in a repo; no design/research/docs. Output is a suggestion only—it won't execute anything.
title_en: Estimate work size, pick the right next step
